verified_by_inspection: Four application-only tables have restrictive ownership/dependency foreign keys; immutable revision and prepared-operation inputs have PostgreSQL direct SQL guards and corresponding ORM fixture guards.
Prepared operation registration precedes activation. Activation locks both operation and investigation, checks the exact head and active state, and commits revision/head/operation/audit together.
Owner-scoped queries remain in force for admin; current application principal and current catalogue policy/lifecycle are checked for context and historical reads.
Attachments and pins remain separate; explicit submission revisions are resolved without adopting the current head or another conversation narrative.
Refresh branches retain exact predecessor identity and original bytes, expose unresolved references, and do not infer object replacements.
Cross-store partial/uncertain results retain references and prepared identity; retries inspect the exact candidate without compensating deletion or release.
Committed retry now verifies stored revision JSON, payload SHA256 and snapshot identity through the same revision reader as historical access.
Hold and retirement operations share the site advisory transaction lock; ancestor holds and active/preparing branches preserve records, while retirement never deletes bytes or releases references.
The request route counts streaming bytes before retaining each chunk, caches the bounded body for FastAPI, rejects ambiguous/nonfinite/invalid UTF-8 input, and stops before oversized unread tails.
Worker-owned transaction/session cleanup and response serialization finish before the cancellation checkpoint; errors and auth responses are sanitized and no-store.
